[Sciviews-news] New packages svSweave
messages.body_plain:
There is a new package on the SciViews tree on R-Forge: svSweave. This 
package will contain specific functions required by R and LyX in the 
framework of the development of SciViews-LyX (an enhanced LyX version 
that communicates with R, uses Sweave documents and edit R code in 
Komodo Edit)
Best,

PhG

messages.subject: [Sciviews-news] tcltk2
messages.body_plain:
The tcltk2 package is distributed on CRAN since a long time. A new 
version (1.0-9) is now added to R-Forge. Major changes target the 
elimination of all executables/dlls from the package. Remaining C code 
is compiled. The package is also reworked to better play with Tcl/Tk 8.5.
Best,

PhG
